Version 1.1.4 of xiaohongshu-creator-screening

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to clarify input rules, call scenarios, and usage principles.
- Expanded usage examples and best practices for all four major capabilities (关键词搜索, 博主作品抓取, 笔记详情, 笔记评论分析).
- Enhanced description of output data, scenario routing, and response expectations.
- Refined guidance on error handling and follow-up actions based on user input.
- No functional logic changes; this release focuses on complete and structured user guidance.
